blurb: Guests enjoy various rides including go karts, bumper boats, a climbing wall, and a mini golf course with 18 holes. The park features a unique go kart track, a bungee trampoline, an arcade, and a rock climbing wall. Food and souvenirs are available at the Windmill and concession stands.
